title: Decision on the Registration of Pharmaceutical Products No. 0622/MOH; dated 02 April 2025
text:
This regulation establishes the principles, rules, and procedures for the registration of pharmaceutical products to ensure that all pharmaceuticals manufactured domestically, imported, or exported meet the required standards of quality, safety, and efficacy, and comply with applicable regional and international regulatory requirements for distribution in domestic and international markets.
